traceability.notes:
The story 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX is implemented and fully covered by the `traceability/require-test-traceability` rule and its helpers.
– File-level @supports template insertion (REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE) is implemented in `ensureFileSupportsAnnotation` and `insertSupportsTemplate`, which insert a non-semantic JSDoc block with clear TODO guidance at the top of test files missing any @supports annotation. Tests verify the exact before/after text and that the TODO line and placeholders are present.
– REQ prefix format fixes (REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE) are implemented via `normalizeReqId`, `normalizeReqPrefixInDescription`, and `handleItOrTestCall`. They correct spacing, underscore vs hyphen, casing, and parentheses-to-brackets only when an existing REQ-like identifier is present, and they preserve the rest of the test name and string quoting. Tests cover all example malformed cases ([ REQ-XXX ], [REQ_XXX], [req-xxx], (REQ-XXX)) and also confirm that tests with no prefix only get an error with no auto-fix, satisfying the "no inference" requirement.
– Configuration options `autoFixTestTemplate`, `autoFixTestPrefixFormat`, and `testSupportsTemplate` exist with appropriate defaults and are wired into the rule’s create() function as described in the story.
– The rule is marked `fixable: "code"` and is exercised via ESLint’s RuleTester with expected `output` values, demonstrating correct integration with ESLint’s `--fix` workflow.
– User documentation in `user-docs/api-reference.md` explicitly describes the new auto-fix behavior for Story 021.0, including placeholder template insertion and `[REQ-...]` normalization, fulfilling the documentation acceptance criterion.
Given the concrete implementation, passing tests tied to this story’s requirements, and corresponding documentation, all acceptance criteria for this story are satisfied.
